description: LADOT Traffic Counts Summary is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. LADOT automated and manual traffic count summary data for intersections throughout Los Angeles. Manual counts ("MAN" under the "Type" column) are generally 6-hr counts which have been expanded using a conversion factor. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are manual counts, automated counts, streets, transportation, traffic counts. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Transportation. The portal shows 2017-01-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
